envelope.description: Run the Task sync from the approve flow and the daemon seam

body.title: Run the Task sync from the approve flow and the daemon seam
body.summary: Make approve() in src/cli/services/workflow.ts async and call syncTasksOnPlanApproval before the Task push, update its type in src/cli/services/index.ts and its callers in src/cli/panes/WorkflowsPane.tsx and src/cli/command.ts, add a 'tasks-sync' kind to FollowOnOutcome in src/workflow/gates.ts, and add src/daemon/tasks-sync.ts called at both follow-on sites in src/daemon/index.ts, running the sync and then the Task push.
acceptanceChecks: Approving a plan through the cli flow and through the daemon seam creates the Task set and binds each Task's issue on its TASK head under the Story's issue
approve() is async and its callers await it
A failed sync is reported beside the approval and never fails it, and shows as ok:false in the daemon follow-on

tests.name: task-set-approve.test.ts: approving a plan creates the Task set and each Task's issue is bound on its Task head under the Story's issue, through the cli approve flow and the daemon seam, and a failed sync never fails the approval
